Фенспирида Гидрохлорид C15H20N2O2,HCl = 296.8. CAS — 5053-06-5 (fenspiride); 5053-08-7 (fenspiride hy- drochloride). ATC — R03BX01; R03DX03. ATC Vet — QR03BX01; QR03DX03. (fenspiride) Profile Fenspiride is reported to have bronchodilator and anti-inflamma- tory properties. It is given as the hydrochloride in asthma (p.1108) and other respiratory disorders in usual oral doses of 160 to 240 mg daily in divided doses before meals. It has also been given rectally and by intramuscular or intravenous injec- tion.
